items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: Sidney Ayrton wrote Up a Lazy River... used the clarinet chorus that Sidney Ayrton used to play.

ctx.x: And he's the guy who wrote, uh, Up a Lazy River. Really? He's the guy, he never wrote Up a Lazy River, but Sidney Ayrton wrote Up a Lazy River. Mm-hmm.
